items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy geography countdown Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how wild this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Every 'Number five / four / three / two / one' is a big, punchy countdown call with a tiny pause after it, rising in hype toward number one. Hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy) and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Or is it?' is playful and knowing. 'But the last two get weirder' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'Banned too' is deadpan and funny. The last line trails off unfinished, voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy, about 175 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Accent: native General American English narrator, neutral American accent from the first word to the last. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce Tajikistan as tah-JEE-kih-stan, Qatar as KAH-tar, Bahrain as bah-RAIN, Oman as oh-MAHN.
lines: GTA 6 is BANNED in these five countries... or is it?
Because only one really did it.
Number five: Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
They kept GTA 5 out for twelve years...
...then in twenty twenty-five the ban ended. GTA 6? On sale!
No ban... Sony and Xbox just stopped selling there.
Every foreign game needs a government license... GTA 6 doesn't have one.
But the last two get weirder.
Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman... it's not even on PlayStation.
No ban announced... it's just missing.
In twenty twenty-four, the government banned every GTA game.
Police even announced raids on gaming clubs!
So... which one shocked you most? Because honestly...
